title: The Road Brings the Teller Back

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A slate burns where a room was shut, and the road brings the teller back with the writing turned inward; ask the weather which is true, for nobody stands to be asked.
epigraph.attribution: A yard saying of Low Kiln, told over the boards in the dark month

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and thirty-three to three hundred and thirty-five days, six months and one hundred and fifty-three to one hundred and fifty-five days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory; the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone. Each morning that register takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; he knows the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid through three hundred and thirty-three, thirty-four and thirty-five days and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, not numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go and never among the sources; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, and the told figure beside the paid figure with no signature on the space. Two ownerless movements arrive in these three days — the burned slate joined for the first time to the shut room on Ash 5, and a fourth shaping of the well-saying at the well the same afternoon — and both are taken apart as a wound is taken apart and filed on places of their own with a finger between every pair, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a sixth telling, not a third telling, not a witness, not a cause, not a payment and not a rule.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Fourth Morning of Ash
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{333}{Ash 4, Fourthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Fourthday with no market, Cross or bell. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 240 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; the hand outside the wool comes up for the two hundred and forty-first. No recap of Chapter 93. Carry 332 to 333 exact, six months and 153 days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 333 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Nothing from Ash 1, 2 or 3 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, and the sixth opening at the kiln mouth on Ash 2 is not revisited as a sign and no seventh is made due. Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: crust two inches from the ear, stiff and leathery in the dry kiln heat, corner standing a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. The surgeon knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle. Both true, the second louder, neither wins; the argument is the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with her hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air (T058/T079/T100). Twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack, both proverbs to pot and fire, crack left showing; dressed grain turned under wool with the lighter touch and no figure and no handful; pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T009/T013/T092, T077 held). Widow's mark untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; the fired kiln from Ash 2 stands cold and six openings in six months are six and not a rule. Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; told figure beside paid. File open on the towel with every gap gap; staying, early letting-go, handful, thumb's resting and sixth opening five objects on five places and none made again. Six arithmetics ride locked in Berr's box, one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, no signature, six readings six and not one account; the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the not-doings, covered grain, five held objects or his own gaps — edges nearly touch, finger goes between (T015/T041/T047 carried). Ash 10 (Day 339), the dark month's first Account-day and market, stands six mornings ahead and is not brought in. Answer **241**: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down as a tool put away; note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Yard Goes Around
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 333, no new dated heading: afternoon through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the seven walked-around places, the rack end, the yard well and flat stone, the worked strips, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, the back room from outside, and the bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Tarn, Jorra; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, man with cracked jar in rope sling); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Hessa, no market, no Cross, no bell, no collector. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool and the river wind, never the basket; she goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey thaw unswept both; lowest rack with broken birth-slates; pan's gone ring with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; trough's skin; field's empty place on the worked strips; returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — no eighth likeness, no cause across two, no payer (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair: frost gone off the well's north lip on Bone 3 while the yard looked elsewhere (not a sign); skin on the trough breaking and closing under a pail's knock; silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet (T083/T085 held). Hunts and repairs as directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather: Cold Acre hare answered with the weather and gone toward the clay road with nobody weighing it or opening a slate; cracked jar in a rope sling answered with the pot, and the pot says nothing; a woman's cost-question answered with the weather (T077). At the rack end the dressed grain lies turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure; her fingers go in and come out without closing, and no handful is lifted (T077 held). Tarn at the kindling: six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence; knife at the very edge of its sill where it can be checked and where a hand could slip it off; *Six counted. The next I don't count*; ear-sentence brought to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, pale clip-ring holding light, stroke over the shallow bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness. The thumb's resting on the uncut seventh on Bone 26 is checked as one object and **not made again** on Ash 4: not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a payment, not a fifth held change, not a hearing, not a mending, not a rule (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra at the shed's edge: dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease, not bone-coloured slip; men unnamed going low into the back room before first grey and the room not called cold; wheel first — *It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady* — then *You'll do* to a pot; full note known three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withheld from a High Kiln master who would call it early and make a song of it; bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise of a name to the men who burn slates neither given nor withdrawn. **Ground laid for Scene 3:** the burned slate stands at five with a finger between the fifth and the four, no witness standing and no sixth due; the shut-room tellings stand at two and not three; the damper's two bites are one object joined to no kiln (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Garl in objects: salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line and finer grey unswept, twice-mended pot with both proverbs gone to pot and fire and never to a person, tile debt uncalled, name unspoken 333 days. Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, fold righted without a look at his face, thread left, never the Debt Loft, a sound from above and behind only and no interior entered; fire four and a gap, boards four, four and a knot, river water over water — three counts that do not become one. Answer **242** at the very end: small intake let go whole on the river's note; the note had done before the hand came down, so neither early again nor stayed (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the Boards Said at Mid-month
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{334}{Ash 5, Fifthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the morning and afternoon at the Clay Yard boards, then back to the hearth, the bed, the boards and the towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Jorra; yard walk-ons and the price-of-barley talk; an ownerless voice over the boards; Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Hessa, no Tarn on stage, no collector, no market, no Cross, no bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ash 4 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Carry 333 to 334 exact, six months and 154 days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 334 days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order; composed face not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; surgeon versus infant quarrel, both true, the second louder, the argument the work (T060/T086). Hearth grammar holds: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, *The house will keep it*, intake-hold-letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs and the crack showing, dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077 held). **THE CHAPTER'S FIRST MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T035/T031/T065/T095):** in the afternoon an ownerless voice over the boards of the Clay Yard, on the same breath as the price of barley and the weather, says for the first time that the slate that burned was burned in the room with the damper shut — the Greybank saying about the counting room shut in the war, which the yard has always taken as history eighteen leagues east, spoken here without a date and without a witness standing anywhere to be asked, no room named, no hand at the flame, no owner. The boy takes it apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart and files it on a place of its own: a first joining of the burned slate to the shut room said aloud by nobody standing, **not a sixth telling of the burned slate**, not a third telling of the shut room that anyone can carry into a chart, not a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a cause, a confession or a rule, with no payer and no name under it. Five tellings stay five with a finger between the fifth and the four; two shut-room tellings stay two; the claim goes on gathering interest against Jorra's promise, which is neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T065/T095 advanced, not paid). Sella hears it and tells the fire it is the thaw — she who lost a husband to that danger and has never once described it that way herself — and gives no name to the voice and no figure to the saying. Jorra grows quieter as it goes around the boards and the household straightens around the quiet without an order from her; his bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of her unfinished sentence, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise stays ungiven. Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the finding that six readings are six and not one account kept on a place of its own with no payer (T015/T041/T047 carried). Answer **243**: hand up an inch, small intake held whole, let go on the river's note, straight down as a tool put away; neither early again nor stayed (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Well Gives the Saying a Fourth Shape
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 5 through the going of the light and the small hours at the yard well, the flat stone, the seven walked-around places, the rack end, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge and damper, and the bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Ilva (once at the well, strip unread, ninth hand), Tarn, Jorra; a woman asking at the well; an ownerless voice at the well; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, cracked-jar man); Garl in objects. No Hessa, no market, no Cross, no bell, no collector. At the yard well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp as the bucket comes up, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; her hands know the weight of a pail and the edge of a wet board and have never been soft, and people notice the pail first and the sleeve not at all. A woman asks what the firings of Ash have taken. Ilva's hand goes toward her sleeve and stays; the short strip of notched birch bark, pale where a thumb has rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between, is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, the cord, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, and no figure comes off the wood. Eyes to the asker, mouth opening after both with a half-beat: *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account.* Flat hand once more on the sleeve and back to the pail, nobody turning twice. The boy takes the order of reaching apart as a surgical field is taken apart and files it as the **ninth** record-first hand on its own place with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth; he files **no tenth**, makes no figure of the slate's nearness and does not make her a reader of her own keeping (T080 held). **THE CHAPTER'S SECOND MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T080):** an ownerless voice at the well, with no owner standing anywhere to be asked, no room, no hand at a slate, no name for the person, no figure, no confession and no cause, gives the Frost 14 well-saying a **fourth shaping** — the runner who carried the figure has come back down the road with the slate turned toward her. The weather answers first and the price of barley after it, and the voice goes off up the terrace while the saying stands where it stood; four shapings are still not a witness, for a witness stands somewhere and can be asked and none stood. The boy files the fourth shaping on a place of its own beside the first saying and the three earlier shapings with a finger between every pair, and expressly does **not** join the voice to Ilva drawing a pace away, does not make her the speaker of it, does not lay it across the Ash 5 joining over the boards, Ilva's strip, Berr's twice-wiped thumb, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate or the charcoal under the shelf, and does not make Hessa a reader or pay the claim (T080 advanced, not paid). Hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the arm and the weather, never figures; three coverings stay weather entered nowhere (T077, T083/T085 held). Tarn at the kindling keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, clip-ring holding light, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying; the thumb's resting on the uncut seventh of Bone 26 is checked and **not made again** on Ash 5 (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra at the wheel-shed: grey dust ground small as meal past the bent finger, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, men unnamed before first grey, wheel first and a pot after, full note known three turns ahead and withheld from a High Kiln master, bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, *he's not Vail* sealed, promise ungiven, burned slate at five with the Ash 5 joining held on a place of its own and no sixth telling (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095 held). Garl stays in objects with his name unspoken 334 days and his tile debt uncalled. Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, fold righted without a look, thread left, never the Debt Loft, a sound from above and behind only; fire four and a gap, boards four, four and a knot, river water over water — three counts that do not become one. Answer **244** at the very end: small intake let go whole on the river's note; neither early again nor stayed (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Sixth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{335}{Ash 6, Sixthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Sixthday with no market, Cross or bell. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella; Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Tarn, no Jorra, no Hessa on stage this morning, no collector. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ash 5 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Carry 334 to 335 exact, six months and 155 days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 335 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: crust two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. Composed face not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; infant wants crust lifted, thread wiped, hand on pot handle — both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Hearth grammar holds the morning after the mid-month sayings: fire before basket; coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot; *The house will keep it*; intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured; finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread; lips along a two-gapped row unfigured; one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air; twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing; dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful; pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). Widow's mark untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months are six and not a rule and no seventh is made due (T058/T079). The two Ash 5 movements are held on places of their own with a finger between them and between them and Ilva's strip, Berr's thumb, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate and the charcoal under the shelf; the burned slate stays at five with the joining held apart and no sixth telling, the well-saying stays at four shapings with no fifth and no witness, and neither movement makes Hessa a reader or Jorra a payer (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T080 held, advanced and not paid). Domestic texture gathers toward later without becoming a sign: grey streak at her temple showing pale, coal-black hair pushed back with the burn-wrist, the little-door burn closing on nothing when she carries a cup, the day kept in loaves, glances and unnamed spaces and never in a figure. Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; told figure beside paid; file open on the towel with every gap left gap; five held objects on five places with a finger between every pair and none made again. Six arithmetics ride locked in Berr's box, one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, no signature, six readings six and not one account, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the not-doings, covered grain, five held objects or his gaps — the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047 carried). Ash 10 (Day 339), the dark month's first Account-day and market, stands four mornings ahead and is not brought in; Ash's first arithmetic belongs to its own morning. Answer **245**: hand up an inch toward the river's note, small intake, interval held whole, let go on the same low note, straight down as a tool put away; neither early again nor stayed (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Runner Comes Down the Road
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 335, Ash 6, the afternoon at the Clay Yard, the seven walked-around places, the rack end, the yard well and flat stone, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and damper, the clay road, and the bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella, Tarn, Jorra, Hessa Rale (glimpsed once coming down the clay road); walk-ons (Cold Acre hare-carrier, cracked-jar man, woman with basket of kindling, two men mending a strip of fence); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Berr, no green-mouthed woman, no foundling at the close, no collector up or down the road, no market, Cross or bell. **THE CHAPTER'S THIRD MOVEMENT, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T080):** Hessa Rale is glimpsed coming **down** the clay road — not up toward Greybank as on an Account-day — with the writing of Berr's narrow slate turned toward herself for the first time, still edge-on to her forearm, still unread, the thumb along the grain of the frame and nothing pressing where the writing is, no figure coming off it and no choosing made. The second strap is let out for the long road; dried pale scurf of road-mud stands unbrushed on the shortened skirt; her hand goes to the slate before her eyes go to the yard. To a woman who asks what she carries she answers the question put and not the one behind it: *Ask the road. It knows the way and I know the weight. That's the whole of what either of us knows.* She is a runner and not a reader, her order of reaching stays the **eighth** record-first hand on a place of its own with no tenth, and she is not joined to Marra, the soft-handed man of Slate Row, the clerks, Ilva, the green-mouthed woman, the Drawing collector or the woman whose voice came over the boards. The boy files the turning of the writing toward herself on a place of its own **beside** the fourth shaping from the well on Ash 5, with a finger between: the voice said the runner had come back down the road, and here she comes, but a voice standing in no doorway is not a prophecy fulfilled, and he refuses to join the saying to the sighting, to make a fifth shaping, to make Hessa a reader, to make the sighting a payment or to pay the claim (T080 advanced, not paid). The Ash 5 joining over the boards and the fourth shaping at the well stay on separate places with a finger between them and between them and Ilva's strip, Berr's thumb, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate and the charcoal (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T080 held). The yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between pairs; the month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: Cold Acre hare answered with the weather and gone toward the clay road with nobody weighing it or opening a slate; cracked jar in a rope sling answered with the pot, and the pot says nothing; woman with a basket of kindling asks what the seventh year will want and two fence-menders say the thaw will be early and late; Tarn says *Yes, house* to each and keeps the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument can find a foot (T009/T013/T092, T077, T083/T085 held, T098 carried, T036/T076). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the very edge of its sill, ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, clip-ring holding light, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness; thumb's resting on the uncut seventh of Bone 26 checked and **not made again** on Ash 4, 5 or 6 (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra at the shed's edge and damper: grey dust ground small as meal past the bent finger, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, men unnamed before first grey, wheel first and a pot after, full note known three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withheld from a High Kiln master who would call it early and make a song of it, bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, *he's not Vail* sealed, the promise neither given nor withdrawn, the burned slate at five with the Ash 5 joining held apart and no sixth telling and no seventh made due (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). The whole tray is checked and left as it lay: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told bell, the told figure beside the paid with no signature, seven a colour and seven a shape with no eighth, nine record-first hands with Hessa's eighth and Ilva's ninth apart and no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the row at five askings with no witness and expressly no sixth (T101 held, T061/T082, T078, T050/T051, T033/T034 held, T090 held). Garl stays in objects: salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat nobody fills, clean dark line and finer grey unswept, twice-mended pot on the pot board with the hairline of the original break showing between the old-brass staple and the tighter wire and both proverbs gone to pot and fire and never to a person, so repair stays apart from restoration; tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with and worse for being uncalled; his name unspoken 335 days, no lesson made (T009/T013/T092). Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven walked-around places, sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face, lets her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed before it goes away, leaves the thread where it lay; says nothing of where they have been, gives the instruction to the fire, the wool and the pot and never to the basket, and says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I. The widow's mark hangs where it hung and is not touched, because a going of the light and a bed are not openings and six openings in six months are six and not a rule. She goes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw and turns them with the back of a broken pot; the fire answers four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed 335 days. Finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread; lips along a two-gapped row unfigured; one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air; twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing; dressed grain under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, her fingers going in and coming out without closing (T058/T079/T100, T077). Under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand; overhead the boards keep four nails on the near board, four on the next and a thumb-width knot where a fifth might have been driven and was not; through the finger's-width door water over water goes low over lower, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, not numbered among the hearings. Three counts in three places and none rises into another, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands to any. The finding that six are six and not one account stays on a place of its own with no payer and is not laid across the house's not-doings, the dressed grain, the five held objects, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps; the edges come near to touching and the finger goes between; no doctrine stands up out of any of it, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T015/T041/T047). Answer **246** at the very end: the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole, lets the intake go on the same low note and comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. The note had done before the hand came down, so the letting-go was neither early again nor stayed and the hand did not stay; the inch was not a reach, the intake not a breath kept for warmth, the interval not a stopping of the river and the note not his. Filed as answer 246: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the six arithmetics, the bell's gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go, the sixth opening, the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping, Hessa's turned writing nor his own kept gaps. **Two hundred and forty-six honest answers** stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and neither the number nor the small hand-movings that made it stood up and called themselves a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. The surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field left as found and an answer entered where nobody can see it; the infant underneath takes none, wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the two registers quarrelling without verdict in the small hours. **335 stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath; six months and 155 days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth unpaid the same number with its payer unnamed; the name of the man the salt-stiff coat kept unspoken the same number.** Nothing on Ash 6 was opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended. Ash keeps its middle days without a boundary drawn and neither habit of naming the months is set right; the keeping of the number was the only honest work there was to do, bought nothing at two inches of air, was not for sale, and went on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax. The silt-clouded plate of ice stands on its flat stone out of the path of feet; the file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap; the hand lies back against the fold on answer 246; the runner's writing is turned toward herself and no figure has come off the slate; and the river's low note goes quiet under the finger's-width door. Ash 10 (Day 339), the dark month's first Account-day and market, stands four mornings ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it; Ash's first arithmetic belongs to its own morning. Forward, not closed; no ending, epilogue or doctrine.
